title: Adana Lamb Kebap
description: A classic Turkish dish of lamb minced and mixed with spices, then grilled on skewers. Serve with roasted vegetables and pita bread.

ingredients.name: Lamb mince
ingredients.notes: Use 80/20 or 70/30 lean to fat ratio

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: Sweet or hot, whichever suits your taste

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, combine lamb mince, chopped onion, minced garlic, red pepper, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
3. Mix everything together with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.
4. Soak 8-10 bamboo skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
5. Thread the lamb mixture onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
6. Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt.
7. Grill the skewers over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked to your liking.
8. Serve hot with roasted vegetables and pita bread.
9. Roast the vegetables in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until tender.
10. Slice the pita bread in half and toast in the oven for a few minutes.
